description: This Java class is a Spring MVC Controller named ShoppingOrderDownloadController. It handles HTTP requests related to downloading files associated with orders, specifically for digital products. The main method 'downloadFile' processes download requests by verifying the order, customer, and download file existence, then streams the file content back as an attachment.

classes.name: ShoppingOrderDownloadController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for handling download of order-related files for digital products, including verification of user permissions and constructing HTTP responses with file content.

methods.name: downloadFile
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET requests for downloading order product files. Validates order and customer, retrieves file, and streams it as an attachment in the HTTP response.
